status: PREREGISTERED BEFORE ANY CELL EXISTS -- committed prior to the first ingest
question: Can MemPhant retrieve the official SWE-ContextBench Relationship parent for a target task, when the whole experience pool is the haystack?
why_this_gate_exists: Every downstream paid stage assumes the memory arm can surface the gold prior experience. If it cannot, no amount of agent spend can produce an effect and stages 1 and 2 are cancelled for $0. This is the cheapest possible kill.

haystack.rule: ONE tenant, ONE subject, ONE scope. Every experience row is bound to the same context and every query is issued against that same context.
haystack.why: The retained n=12 rehearsal (scripts/run_swe_contextbench_memphant.py) bound a fresh scope per (target, arm), so recall ranked over a pool of ONE and the citation assertion was trivially satisfiable. That is not a retrieval measurement. The pool must be the whole corpus or the number is meaningless.
haystack.pool_dedup: The parquet has 1,100 rows but only 1,007 distinct instance_ids; all 93 duplicate groups are BYTE-IDENTICAL. Ingest the 1,007 distinct rows. Ingesting the 93 duplicates would create dedup-collapsed or double-weighted units and is not a fair haystack. Duplicate multiplicity is asserted byte-identical at load time and the run ABORTS if that ever stops holding.

queries.source: SWEContextBench_Related.parquet, all 376 rows, census-complete, no selection
queries.query_text: the row's problem_statement, verbatim and alone
queries.duplicate_target_handling: The 376 rows contain only 357 distinct instance_ids; the 19 duplicated ids are NOT byte-identical (they differ in version, problem_statement, FAIL_TO_PASS, PASS_TO_PASS and in one case patch/test_patch/base_commit). Both the row-level census (n=376) and the distinct-task view (n=357) are reported. The distinct-task view is the PRIMARY one, because a duplicated instance is not an independent pair.

gold.source: SWEContextBench_Relationship.parquet, 376 edges, 357 distinct related ids, 229 distinct parents
gold.rule: ANY-PARENT. A query is a hit at k if at least one of its 1-2 official experience parents appears at rank <= k.
gold.also_reported: ALL-PARENT (every parent within top-k) for the 19 two-parent targets, reported separately and never as the headline.
gold.self_retrieval_guard: Related INTERSECT Experience = exactly 1 instance_id. If a query retrieves its own instance that hit is recorded as a self-retrieval and EXCLUDED from the ranking; it is not counted as a gold hit.

endpoints.primary: retrieval recall@k of the gold parent, taken from the recall trace's candidate fused_rank -- i.e. did the retriever rank it, independent of packing
endpoints.secondary: packed recall@k, taken from the ranked /v1/recall items -- i.e. did the gold parent survive into the context the agent would actually see
endpoints.why_both: The rung-7 render-cap verdict established that in-pool-but-unpacked misses are budget drops, not retrieval failures. Reporting only one of these two numbers hides which subsystem is at fault. The AGENT sees the packed one; the RETRIEVER is graded by the trace one.
miss_taxonomy: absent_from_candidates -- the retriever never surfaced the parent at any rank
ranked_below_cut -- the parent has a fused_rank greater than k
dropped -- the parent was a candidate and was discarded, with the trace's RecallDropReason recorded verbatim

decision_rule.primary_statistic: packed recall@5 of the gold parent over the 357 distinct targets, ANY-PARENT
decision_rule.GREEN: packed recall@5 >= 0.50 -- the memory arm sees the gold parent for at least half of targets. Stage 1 proceeds.
decision_rule.AMBER: 0.20 <= packed recall@5 < 0.50 -- retrieval is live but weak. Stage 1 proceeds ONLY if the trace shows the dominant miss class is packing/budget rather than absent_from_candidates, because that is a lever we already own (pack_render_cap). Otherwise stage 1 is cancelled.
decision_rule.RED: packed recall@5 < 0.20 -- CANCEL stages 1 and 2. MemPhant cannot find the gold prior experience, so it cannot express the effect the instrument measures, and $544 would buy a null we already know the cause of.
decision_rule.no_post_hoc_threshold_movement: These three bands are fixed at commit time. A result landing 1pp under a band boundary is that band.
decision_rule.floor_note: This is a retrieval proportion over 357 independent queries, not a paired McNemar contrast, so the n_d >= 6 discordant-pair floor does not apply to it. The floor applies to stages 1 and 2 and is untouched.

mechanism_liveness.rule: MECHANISM LIVENESS BEFORE ACCURACY. No recall number may be reported unless all of the following hold, each asserted in code with the run aborting on failure.
assertions: every one of the 1,007 retain calls returned an id
gr.drain_worker completed and gr.assert_worker_queue_empty confirms pending=0 and dead=0 against the bench credential, not the worker's self-report
the compiled corpus contains at least one memory_unit per ingested experience, counted by SQL on the scratch DB
every /v1/recall response carries a trace_id and the trace fetch succeeds
the unit_id -> source_ref map is loaded by SQL from memphant.memory_unit so candidate-trace units resolve to instance_ids without relying on citations
mechanism_liveness.silence_is_not_a_valid_outcome: Any assertion failure aborts the chain at the first failure and the artifact records ABORTED, never a partial number.

required_in_artifact: every parquet sha256 re-verified on disk against the lock

known_confounds_declared_up_front: The ingested body is the Option-A direct-row body (problem_statement + hints_text + patch + created_at). This is NOT the paper's pool, which is agent trajectories (avg 25,633.7 tokens) or gold summaries (avg 217.1 tokens). Our memory is different from, and probably stronger than, Table 3's oracle-summary arm. This must be labelled on every downstream claim.

Gold patches predate their targets by construction, so there is no target leakage; but the patch is nevertheless a stronger signal than a summary and inflates retrievability relative to the paper's construction.

The pool is global and unfiltered by time. Some pool rows postdate a given target. The count of such rows is reported but they are NOT removed, because the memory arm at stage 2 would hold the same global pool.

15 of the 376 relationship edges are cross-repo. Same-repo pool size per target has median 57, min 0, max 345, so per-target haystack difficulty varies by an order of magnitude and the aggregate recall rate averages over that.
what_this_gate_does_not_measure: task resolution -- no agent runs, no Docker, no grader
whether retrieving the parent helps -- Table 4 shows memory can find the right code and then break the patch
any effect size, any comparison to a published arm
